DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-viral Cough (Post-infectious Cough)

The combination of a recent upper respiratory infection, nonproductive cough, and a normal chest X-ray makes post-infectious cough the most likely explanation, despite the nocturnal worsening which can mimic asthma or GERD.
